content: P0420 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1). The catalytic converter is not reducing emissions as efficiently as expected. Causes include a failing catalytic converter, exhaust leaks upstream of the sensor, or failing O2 sensors. Inspect exhaust system and O2 sensor activity.

P0430 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2). The catalytic converter for bank 2 is not reducing emissions as efficiently as expected. Causes include a failing catalytic converter, exhaust leaks, or failing O2 sensors. Inspect exhaust system and O2 sensor activity.

P0422 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 1, Bank 2 combined in some calibrations). The catalytic converter efficiency is below the minimum threshold. Causes include internal substrate breakdown, oil contamination, or physical damage. Inspect converter and exhaust system.

P0432 - Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold (Bank 2, Bank 1 combined in some calibrations). The catalytic converter efficiency for bank 2 is below the minimum threshold. Causes include internal substrate breakdown, oil contamination, or physical damage. Inspect converter and exhaust system.
